# Ex 17 · More Files

从一个文件读，写到另一个文件——迷你「复制」。

## 目标
- 读 `from.txt` 全文
- 写入 `to.txt` 并核对长度

## 自检
- [ ] `to.txt` 内容与 `from.txt` 一致
- [ ] 打印了复制的字节/字符数

starterFiles.ex17.py:
from_file = "from.txt"
to_file = "to.txt"

print(f"Copying from {from_file} to {to_file}")
with open(from_file) as infile:
    data = infile.read()

print(f"The input file is {len(data)} characters long")
with open(to_file, "w") as outfile:
    outfile.write(data)

print("All done. Re-read the copy:")
with open(to_file) as f:
    print(f.read())
